`release.json` and `package.json` are the public production 67 selection verified
on September 18, 2026. `scoring-vectors.json` is copied from Six7's shared
`ios/Six7/Six7Tests/Fixtures/hand-motion-modules.json`.

`pose.jpg` is the official MediaPipe test example from
https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-assets/pose.jpg and is used only to
verify actual model loading/inference. Google documentation examples:
https://developers.google.com/edge/mediapipe/solutions/vision/pose_landmarker
(CC BY 4.0 documentation / Apache 2.0 code). This static-image test does not
establish motion accuracy or physical-phone performance.
